recommendations.title: Name the 2–3 people who can make or break this project
recommendations.action: Capture sponsor, delivery lead, and anyone skeptical — with what they care about.
recommendations.why: Without named stakeholders, coaching and updates stay generic.
recommendations.leadershipImpact: You look prepared because you already know who matters.

recommendations.title: Set the next visible milestone with a date
recommendations.action: Pick one near-term win stakeholders can see, and put a date on it.
recommendations.why: A project without a next visible win drifts into status theatre.
recommendations.leadershipImpact: You create forward motion people can trust.

recommendations.title: Log the first risk or open loop
recommendations.action: Write down what could surprise a stakeholder if left unspoken this week.
recommendations.why: Empty risk lists are usually optimism, not control.
recommendations.leadershipImpact: You surface issues before they surface you.
